title: MagCache + NetDist integration contract
purpose: Concrete interface contract and adapter stub for combining ComfyUI-MagCache (inference-time caching) with ComfyUI_NetDist (multi-GPU/multi-machine dispatch). Describes the precise ordering of nodes, the shared assumptions each pack makes, and the failure modes that arise when the two are combined. Documentation only; not executed.
